notes:
Slice L11a covers 25 ratified log entries, D-024 to D-138, reading Status and Position only. I read the worktree at f14dbc1d and made no edits. The only file I created is the probe /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/L11a/probe.jl. It ran once, and every probe line I cite is a line of that file.

Results: 183 claims. 144 are ok, 33 are findings and 6 are unverifiable.

All 33 findings are class drift. Each is a code identifier or rule that a later ratified entry moved. In nearly every case the entry's own dated Annotation paragraph already records the move: log.md lines 1018, 1049, 1073, 1431, 1586, 2876, 3495, 3534, 3538, 3578, 3614, 3735, 4232, 4395-4401, 4500, 4505 and 4798. D-095's annotation sits in its Rationale. Three findings have no annotation, though a later entry still records the move: L11a-105 (hasmethod vs which, D-371), L11a-121 (report vs report!, D-160) and L11a-153 (the compared set, D-274 and D-462). The verifier may judge whether an annotated drift still needs a row. I listed them all as the task's rule asks.

The 6 unverifiable claims cover two cases. L11a-009 is mapping purity, an author obligation the code never checks. L11a-027, 061, 062 and 067 are GUI widget conventions with no shipped GUI since D-310. L11a-148 is the 'recorders' vocabulary, which has no code term.

Leads (15) each end in a row:
- Findings: get_local, get_slot and local_types (L11a-083, 084, 085), capture twice (131, 136), event_budget (154), ReplayHeaderMismatch (155), stop_on (151), ReadBindingUnresolved (170) and interactive (172).
- ok: get_ (082), StaleInteractiveEntry (059, its death as stated), user_callback! (034, its elimination as stated) and ControlLaws (066, FlightCore prior art).

Citations:
- Every D-nnn citation in the Positions resolves: D-029, D-044, D-047, D-061, D-074, D-083, D-091, D-093, D-095, D-106, D-125 and D-133.
- Every § citation resolves to a spec heading: §8.5, §11.1-§11.4, §11.6, §12.4, §12.6, §12.7, §14, §14.2, §14.4 and §14.9.
- No entry in the slice carries a superseded status. D-127's Position cites D-091, which is superseded by D-255, and D-255 is ratified.

Side observation, outside the Position: D-127's annotation (log.md:4399) says `n` is `N_base` since D-234. No `N_base` field or keyword exists in src/, because the deployment's fields are Δt_frame, Δt_base, h_max, h_min, … (probe:51). The annotation is therefore stale too.
